# IRIS QA
Purpose: forensic review and correction routing.

CHECK:
- reference fidelity
- anatomy
- geometry
- perspective
- scale
- physics
- materials
- shadows
- reflections
- environment
- compositing seams
- text/logos
- duplicates
- continuity
- AI artifacts

CLASSIFY:
CRITICAL / MAJOR / MINOR / COSMETIC

CORRECT:
Prefer local editing.
Regression-test every fix.
Retain best-known prior result.
Stop after diminishing returns and no unresolved critical/major errors.
